stable.label: weather3d-volume-runtime-ci-pass
stable.note: The active /genesis-codehood/ route loads the compiler-proven Weather3D V2 ↔ native material-volume bridge through one coupled C++/WASM worker. One-way native water-to-body forces are now promoted on main as an isolated native subsystem, but native body mechanics/material/hydrodynamics are still not loaded by the active browser route. Runtime browser execution and iPhone device execution remain unverified.

A separate promoted one-way hydrodynamics increment now applies buoyancy proxy, relative-flow drag and pressure-gradient force from real native water fields. Body-to-fluid reaction, wakes/displacement, added mass, lift and turbulence remain absent, and swimming is not claimed.

weather_volume_coupling_v1.truth: The coupled bridge is loaded by /genesis-codehood/ and has exact-main CI, browser-contract, Foundation, Stable↔Lab, and Pages deployment evidence. It is still not LIVE_TESTED or DEVICE_TESTED. Hydrodynamic body forces now exist separately on main but are not loaded into this browser runtime; neither subsystem is validated CFD or NWP.

hydrodynamics_lane.truth: PR #124 was reconciled onto the authoritative current volume solver without modifying volume3d/solver.cpp, independently proved, merged, and then passed exact-main Foundation/Stable↔Lab/Pages gates. It provides one-way water-to-body forces only and remains isolated from the active browser runtime.

superseded_world_weather_v1.truth: Preserved historical proof only. It must not be used as the active weather target or as evidence for Weather3D V2 beyond independently shared gates.

native_volume_renderer.truth: WebGPU ray marching is presentation over native 3D state; time-driven fake water-normal animation is forbidden; water normals derive from native water-density gradients and turbidity derives from native suspended sediment, never pressure.

active_objective: Promote the existing native body mechanics + material contact + one-way hydrodynamic force stack into the authoritative /genesis-codehood/ runtime without creating a duplicate body, fluid, weather or rendering solver.
next_gate: Use the existing native body/body-material/hydrodynamics sources as one runtime path, regenerate any affected zero-import C++→WASM payload from exact sources, prove deterministic body + voxel-contact + one-way fluid-force behavior, add a fail-closed browser contract, then require Foundation and main-only Stable↔Lab before promotion.
next_scientific_blocker: Native body mechanics, voxel contact and one-way hydrodynamic forces are individually CI-proven on main but remain isolated from the authoritative browser route. The next bounded blocker is runtime body promotion, not another solver and not stronger fluid claims.
